posts.text:
if maga means whoever and whatever trump likes, orban’s the guy. 

if maga is about traditional social values, secure borders, draining the swamp and taking care of your own citizens first…orban’s a disgrace and they should’ve supported magyar from the beginning.  

speaks volumes about trump/vance that they made that decision.

in hungary tonight democracy wins

Video
us blockade doesn’t take effect until after markets open. hmm.

in other news, hungary pm orban set to lose big today. 

vance 0 for 2 on the weekend.

after his electoral loss, orban offers a parting lesson to the americans by conceding defeat.


Magyar Péter (Ne féljetek) (@magyarpeterMP)

Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has just called to congratulate us on our victory.



— https://nitter.net/magyarpeterMP/status/2043408618834325568#m

president trump and vp vance supporting orban was a self defeating move. he’s been a stooge of putin, china’s most committed trade partner in europe and a staunch opponent of america’s closest allies,

orban getting absolutely hammered, as expected, in hungary. 

after 16 years of incompetence, mismanagement and europe’s most kleptocratic governance by a long margin…a historic win for the hungarian people.
may looking very ambitious for the rescheduled trump-xi summit.
since a blockade is an act of war, is the ceasefire holding?

trump declaring the war over doesn’t resolve iran blocking the strait. 

but trump has said that’s for other countries to figure out, since he doesn’t have an easy way to do it himself. 

many countries are doing so (by paying for transit). this also explains why the united states has suspended oil sanctions on iran.

if trump’s highest priority now is ending the war he started, best move is define in purely unilateral terms: “the war is over in 2-3 weeks, “i already won,” “i don’t care if talks succeed or fail.”

challenge: gives iran very little incentive to concede anything.

iran’s nuclear & ballistic missile programs were a real threat. more to israel and the gulf states than than to the united states, but real nonetheless. 

responding to that threat with an all out regime change war is one of the most irresponsible foreign policy decisions the united states has made in my lifetime. 

we will suffer the consequences of this mistake for years for years to come.

orban’s hungary by the numbers

2025 gdp growth: 0.4%
investment down 20% over last two years 
core inflation over 5%
hungarian bond yields: second highest in the eu

president trump prepared to strengthen the deeply underperforming hungary economy under prime minister viktor orban’s continued leadership. 

unclear whether this offer applies under future prime minster peter magyar, who is about to win sunday’s election.

trump doesn’t have a plan to reopen the strait. 

as long as that remains the case, extended negotiations without a breakthrough serve both the united states and the islamic republic.
